benefits.title: Benefits of Laser Vein Removal
items: Non-Invasive & Precise
Targets unwanted veins without surgery, incisions, or scarring.
Improves Leg & Skin Appearance
Fades spider veins, varicose veins, and facial veins for smoother, clearer skin.
Quick & Comfortable
Most sessions take less than an hour with minimal discomfort.
Little to No Downtime
Resume normal activities immediately after treatment.
Safe & Long-Lasting Results
Uses advanced medical technology approved for effective vein removal.

tabs.label: Treatment Overview
tabs.html: Laser Vein Removal is a safe, non-invasive solution for eliminating unwanted spider veins, varicose veins, and facial veins. Using advanced light-based technology, it collapses and fades visible veins without damaging surrounding skin. At NewDermaMed, our medical team customizes treatment plans based on your vein type, location, and lifestyle needs to help you achieve smooth, clear, and healthy-looking skin.
tabs.text: Laser Vein Removal is a safe, non-invasive solution for eliminating unwanted spider veins, varicose veins, and facial veins. Using advanced light-based technology, it collapses and fades visible veins without damaging surrounding skin. At NewDermaMed, our medical team customizes treatment plans based on your vein type, location, and lifestyle needs to help you achieve smooth, clear, and healthy-looking skin.

tabs.label: What to Expect
tabs.html: A session usually lasts 30–60 minutes, depending on the treatment area and number of veins. Patients may feel a warming or snapping sensation as the laser targets the vein, but discomfort is minimal. Following treatment, you may experience mild redness or swelling, which typically subsides within a few hours to days. Normal activities can be resumed almost immediately.
tabs.text: A session usually lasts 30–60 minutes, depending on the treatment area and number of veins. Patients may feel a warming or snapping sensation as the laser targets the vein, but discomfort is minimal. Following treatment, you may experience mild redness or swelling, which typically subsides within a few hours to days. Normal activities can be resumed almost immediately.

tabs.label: How it Works
tabs.html: The treatment delivers focused laser energy into the vein, which is absorbed by the blood, causing the vein to collapse and eventually be reabsorbed by the body. Over time, the vein fades, and blood flow naturally redirects to healthier veins. For larger or deeper veins, additional options such as sclerotherapy, endovenous laser treatment (EVLT), or radiofrequency ablation may be recommended.

Over time, the vein fades, and blood flow naturally redirects to healthier veins. For larger or deeper veins, additional options such as sclerotherapy, endovenous laser treatment (EVLT), or radiofrequency ablation may be recommended.

tabs.label: Maintenance
tabs.html: Most patients require a series of treatments for optimal results, depending on the size and number of veins. Once treated, the targeted veins do not return; however, new veins may develop over time due to genetics, lifestyle, or circulation issues. Regular follow-ups and healthy habits, including sun protection and staying active, can help maintain long-lasting results.

why.title: Who is Laser Vein Removal For?
why.html:
Laser Vein Removal is an excellent option for individuals struggling with visible veins that affect both appearance and comfort. It is ideal for those with spider veins, reticular veins, varicose veins, or small facial capillaries who want a safe, non-surgical solution. This treatment is suitable for men and women seeking to improve skin clarity, reduce discoloration, and restore confidence.

It’s especially recommended if you experience:

  • Spider veins on the face or legs that appear red, purple, or blue

  • Varicose veins that are enlarged, twisted, or causing discomfort

  • Circulation-related vein concerns like swelling or heaviness in the legs

  • Cosmetic concerns from visible surface veins impacting your confidence

A consultation is always the best way to determine candidacy, as our team can assess your vein type, overall health, and treatment goals to design the safest and most effective plan for you.

items: 1. Are there any side effects?

Most who experience Laser Vein Reduction procedures report few if any side effects from the procedure. The most commonly reported side effect is flushing, or mild swelling upon the sight of treatment. Most of these side effects will subside within a 24 hour period. Light bruising and in rare instances, blistering may occur.

Most who experience Laser Vein Reduction procedures report few if any side effects from the procedure. The most commonly reported side effect is flushing, or mild swelling upon the sight of treatment. Most of these side effects will subside within a 24 hour period. Light bruising and in rare instances, blistering may occur.
2. How many treatments will I need?

We often recommend one to three treatments as an average series. Results will vary per individual subjective to size, number and colour of vessel being treated. Some vessels will clear immediately after contact with the laser, others will begin to fade over the course of a few days to a few weeks requiring a repeat treatment. A detailed and personal evaluation can be given during a one on one consultation.

3. What types of Veins can be treated?

A consultation with a NewDermaMed professional will address which vessels can be safely most effectively treated.

4. Are Laser Vein Procedures painful?

Most who experience Laser Vein Treatments, find a brief snapping or stinging sensation on the site of treatment as the pulses of energy are delivered to each area. No local anesthetic or oral medications are required, however those who prefer to, may select either option prior to commencing each treatment.

Those have leg vein treatments may be advised to wear support hose for a short period of time to eliminate strain and encourage healing.

why.html:
How Does Juvéderm® Work?

Juvéderm® uses hyaluronic acid, a hydrating molecule that attracts and retains moisture to plump skin, restore volume, and smooth wrinkles instantly. This quick, minimally invasive treatment takes 15–30 minutes with little downtime. Results appear immediately, last for months, and integrate naturally into the skin for a soft, youthful look that enhances facial contours and smoothness.

Juvéderm® Filler Options

Juvéderm® offers a range of fillers designed for different needs and lasting results. Voluma XC restores cheek and mid-face volume for up to 2 years, while Ultra XC enhances lips and smooths moderate wrinkles for up to 12 months. Ultra Plus XC treats deeper wrinkles and folds, lasting up to 12 months. Volbella XC provides subtle lip enhancement and softens vertical lip lines for up to a year. Volift XC smooths wrinkles and restores mid-face volume for up to 18 months. Volux XC sculpts the jawline and chin with results lasting 18–24 months. SkinVive™ hydrates and revitalizes the skin, with benefits lasting several months.

tabs.label: What to Expect
tabs.html: Usually, a Belkyra® session lasts 20 to 30 minutes. Our specialist will perform a series of tiny injections beneath the chin and map the treatment area during your visit. tabs.label: How it Works
tabs.html: Deoxycholic acid, a naturally occurring molecule in the body that aids in the breakdown and absorption of dietary fat, is used in the formulation of Belkyra®. Targeted fat cells are safely destroyed when injected under the chin and subsequently naturally removed by the body’s metabolic process. Because these cells cannot grow back once they are removed, the definition of the jawline will remain improved for a long time.

tabs.label: Maintenance

Adults looking for a non-surgical way to reduce stubborn double chin fat can use Belkyra®. Those who are ideal candidates include those who:

  • struggle with localized fat under the chin but are at or close to their ideal weight.
  • Desire long-lasting effects with little recovery time

Those who are pregnant or nursing, have an active infection at the injection site, or have more loose skin than fat are not advised to use this product.

why.title: What is Lip Augmentation?
why.html:
What to expect after a lip filler procedure

  • 24-48 hours of mild soreness and swelling (ice packs can help).
  • For the first 24 hours, stay away from alcohol, heat, and strenuous exercise.
  • Depending on the filler used, final results take 7–14 days to manifest and last 6–15 months.
  • Maintaining your ideal lip shape and volume can be achieved with follow-up appointments.

Lip Flip vs. Lip Augmentation (Botox®)

Lip augmentation is perfect for people who want fuller, plumper results that last 6–12 months because it uses hyaluronic acid dermal fillers to add volume, enhance shape, and define the lips. On the other hand, a lip flip, which lasts for two to three months, uses tiny amounts of Botox® to relax the muscles surrounding the upper lip, making it roll upward and appear more noticeable without adding volume. A lip flip is appropriate for patients who want a subtle, natural-looking lift, while lip augmentation is best for those who want noticeable fullness. For better shape and definition, some patients even decide to combine the two treatments.

why.title: Why Choose Tear Trough Filler?
why.html:
For the sensitive under-eye area, tear trough correction provides several restorative advantages. It restores a smoother transition between the cheek and lower eyelid and fills in deep-set hollows by adding volume. In addition to softening fine lines and wrinkles for a more youthful appearance, this minimizes shadows and lessens dark circles. In addition to adding volume, the hyaluronic acid-based filler hydrates and increases skin elasticity, revitalizing the area beneath the eyes. This non-surgical procedure offers a safe and efficient way to achieve brighter, more rested eyes with instant, natural-looking results and little recovery time.

Who is a Good Candidate for Tear Trough Filler?

  • Individuals with under-eye hollows or dark circles.
  • Those looking for a non-surgical alternative to blepharoplasty.
  • Anyone seeking a refreshed, youthful appearance without downtime.
  • Not suitable for individuals with excess skin laxity or severe under-eye puffiness.

why.html:

tabs.label: Treatment Overview
tabs.html: Microneedling, also called Collagen Induction Therapy (CIT), is a skin rejuvenation treatment that is not very invasive. It improves texture, reduces fine lines, and minimizes scars by making the body produce more collagen. Microneedling makes small, controlled injuries to the skin using a device with very fine needles. This starts the body’s natural healing process. The skin gets smoother, firmer, and looks younger over time. At NewDermaMed, we offer safe and effective medical-grade microneedling treatments that can help with a wide range of skin problems.

Most people can go back to their normal activities the next day, so microneedling is a good choice because it doesn’t take long to recover from. After the first treatment, you can often see a difference, and the best results come from a series of sessions.

IPL also encourages the production of collagen, which makes skin more elastic, toned, and generally better. tabs.label: Treatment Overview
tabs.html: Microdermabrasion is a skin rejuvenation procedure that doesn’t hurt and gently scrubs away dead skin cells, unclogs pores, and makes the skin feel better overall. It helps reduce fine lines, acne scars, sun damage, and uneven pigmentation by encouraging cells to renew themselves and producing more collagen. tabs.text: Microdermabrasion is a skin rejuvenation procedure that doesn’t hurt and gently scrubs away dead skin cells, unclogs pores, and makes the skin feel better overall. It helps reduce fine lines, acne scars, sun damage, and uneven pigmentation by encouraging cells to renew themselves and producing more collagen. This treatment is safe for most skin types and instantly makes the skin look younger, smoother, and brighter.

tabs.label: What to Expect
tabs.html: A normal microdermabrasion session lasts between 30 and 45 minutes. A handheld device, often called a wand, uses fine crystals or a diamond tip to gently “sandblast” the skin’s surface. At the same time, a vacuum system gets rid of dead skin cells and buildup. Most patients say that the treatment feels like a light scratching or vibrating sensation and that it is painless and well-tolerated. You might notice some mild redness right away, but it usually goes away in a few hours, so you can go back to your normal activities right away.

Most patients say that the treatment feels like a light scratching or vibrating sensation and that it is painless and well-tolerated. You might notice some mild redness right away, but it usually goes away in a few hours, so you can go back to your normal activities right away.

tabs.label: How it Works
tabs.html: Microdermabrasion works by removing the top layer of skin (the epidermis) mechanically. This layer is where dead cells, oil, and damage from the environment build up. By taking away this barrier, the skin’s natural process of renewal is sped up, and new, healthier cells grow. The vacuum suction also makes blood flow faster, which boosts the production of collagen and elastin. This makes the skin firmer and more elastic over time.

tabs.label: Treatment Overview
tabs.html: Laser hair removal is a safe, effective, and long-lasting way to get rid of unwanted hair on the body and face. Laser technology, on the other hand, targets hair follicles at the root to stop future growth. Shaving and waxing only give you short-term results. tabs.label: What to Expect
tabs.html: Depending on the area being treated, a typical laser hair removal session lasts between 15 and 60 minutes. A handheld laser sends controlled pulses of light to the hair follicle to target pigment during the procedure. Patients frequently characterize the sensation as a gentle snap against the skin, although cooling technology aids in reducing discomfort. There may be some mild redness or sensitivity afterward, but this usually goes away within a few hours. It takes multiple sessions to get the best results because hair grows in cycles. After each treatment, the hair gets finer and lighter.

tabs.label: How it Works
tabs.html: Laser hair removal works by sending out a focused beam of light that the melanin (pigment) in the hair absorbs. This energy turns into heat, which hurts the follicle and stops hair from growing in the future, but it doesn’t hurt the skin around it. Because only hairs in the anagen (active growth phase) have enough pigment to be effectively treated, you need to have multiple sessions to target all of your follicles at the right stage.

tabs.label: Treatment Overview
tabs.html: Hyperpigmentation is a common skin condition in which certain areas of the skin look darker because they make too much melanin. Melasma, sun spots, post-acne marks, freckles, or an uneven tone are all signs that it could be caused by sun exposure, acne, hormonal changes, inflammation, or genetics. At NewDermaMed, we provide personalized, medical-grade treatments that focus on the underlying causes of pigmentation and also make your skin healthier overall. Our goal is to safely and effectively bring back clarity, balance, and radiance to your skin.

Sessions usually last 30 to 60 minutes and don’t require much time off. As the skin heals, some people may notice redness, mild peeling, or sensitivity. However, most people can go back to their normal activities right away. After the first few sessions, you should start to see improvements, and they should keep getting better over time.

Advanced technologies like lasers, IPL, or special chemical peels go deep into the skin to get rid of melanin deposits and boost collagen production for better tone and texture. These treatments work with medical-grade skin care to fix problems and stop them from happening again, giving you results that last.

Treatment Overview Hyperpigmentation is a common skin condition in which certain areas of the skin look darker because they make too much melanin. Melasma, sun spots, post-acne marks, freckles, or an uneven tone are all signs that it could be caused by sun exposure, acne, hormonal changes, inflammation, or genetics. At NewDermaMed, we provide personalized, medical-grade treatments that focus on the underlying causes of pigmentation and also make your skin healthier overall. Our goal is to safely and effectively bring back clarity, balance, and radiance to your skin. What to Expect A professional skin analysis is the first step in your treatment. It will help us figure out what kind of pigmentation you have and how deep it is. We may suggest depigmentation peels, laser or light-based treatments, microneedling with brightening serums, or medical-grade skin care, depending on what you need. Sessions usually last 30 to 60 minutes and don’t require much time off. As the skin heals, some people may notice redness, mild peeling, or sensitivity. However, most people can go back to their normal activities right away. After the first few sessions, you should start to see improvements, and they should keep getting better over time. How it Works Treatments for hyperpigmentation work by controlling overactive melanocytes (cells that make pigment), breaking down existing pigment, and calming inflammation to stop it from coming back. Advanced technologies like lasers, IPL, or special chemical peels go deep into the skin to get rid of melanin deposits and boost collagen production for better tone and texture. These treatments work with medical-grade skin care to fix problems and stop them from happening again, giving you results that last. Maintenance Ongoing management is important because hyperpigmentation can come back if triggers are not kept under control. Most patients do better with three to six treatments spaced a few weeks apart, followed by maintenance sessions every so often. To keep the results and stop new pigmentation, you need to protect your skin from the sun every day and use the skincare products your doctor recommends. tabs.label: How it Works
tabs.html: Laser resurfacing uses focused light energy to heal skin that has been damaged and encourage new skin growth. Ablative lasers (CO₂, Erbium) take off the top layers of skin and heat the deeper layers to encourage collagen growth. They work best on deep wrinkles, scars, and severe sun damage. Non-ablative lasers (Fraxel, Nd:YAG, PicoSure®) go beneath the skin’s surface without removing it, which makes the skin smoother, reduces fine lines, and evens out pigmentation with little downtime. You can use either method on its own or together to get a balance of results and recovery time that works best for you.

why.title: Who is Melasma Treatment For?
why.html: People with patchy brown or grayish-brown spots on their face or other areas that are exposed to the sun can benefit from melasma treatment. It is especially good for people whose skin color changes because of the sun, hormones, pregnancy, birth control, or genetics. Men and women can both use the treatments, but melasma is most common in women with medium to dark skin tones. If you’ve noticed pigmentation that doesn’t go away with over-the-counter products or discoloration that gets worse in the sun, professional melasma care can help fade spots safely, even out your skin tone, and keep them from coming back with regular care.

tabs.label: Treatment Overview
tabs.html: CoolSculpting is a new, FDA-approved way to shape your body that gets rid of stubborn fat without surgery or downtime. This non-invasive procedure freezes and kills fat cells using controlled cooling technology. The body then naturally gets rid of the dead cells. At NewDermaMed, we offer personalized CoolSculpting treatments that focus on specific areas of concern, like the abdomen, flanks, thighs, arms, double chin, and more. These treatments help you get a slimmer, more sculpted body safely and effectively.

These treatments help you get a slimmer, more sculpted body safely and effectively.

tabs.label: What to Expect
tabs.html: Each area of a CoolSculpting session usually lasts between 35 and 60 minutes. During treatment, a cooling applicator is put on the fat pocket that needs to be treated. Patients feel a firm pull and then a very cold feeling. The area usually goes numb in a few minutes, which makes the procedure comfortable and easy to handle. Patients may have mild redness, swelling, or numbness after treatment, but these symptoms usually go away in a few days to a few weeks. Most people go back to their normal activities right away, and the results slowly become clear over the next 1 to 3 months as the body gets rid of fat cells.

tabs.label: How it Works
tabs.html: Cryolipolysis is a method used by CoolSculpting that cools fat cells under the skin in a controlled way. Fat cells are very sensitive to cold, unlike other types of cells. They freeze, turn into crystals, and then die when they are exposed. The body then naturally gets rid of these cells, leaving behind fewer fat cells in the area that was treated. Patients get natural-looking contouring without surgery, scars, or downtime because the results happen slowly.

Keeping up a healthy lifestyle helps keep results for a long time, but if you gain a lot of weight, new fat cells can still form.

tabs.label: Treatment Overview
tabs.html: IntimaLase is a groundbreaking, non-invasive laser treatment that can help with common issues like stress urinary incontinence (SUI) and restore vaginal tone and elasticity. The vaginal canal and the tissues around it may become weaker and less firm as women get older, have children, or go through hormonal changes. This can cause pain, looseness, or leaking urine. We offer advanced laser vaginal rejuvenation treatments at NewDermaMed that boost collagen production, tighten tissues, and boost self-esteem all without surgery, downtime, or a lot of pain.

Patients can go back to their normal activities right away, but it may be best to avoid sex for a few days. Improvements that can be seen often happen within weeks, and they keep happening as collagen remodeling continues.

benefits.title: Benefits of Endovenous Laser
items: Highly Effective
Proven success rate of up to 98% for treating varicose veins.
Minimally Invasive
Performed inside the vein with no surgical incisions.
No Scarring
Laser energy closes the vein without leaving visible marks.
Quick Recovery
Immediate return to daily activities with little to no downtime.
Improves Circulation
Redirects blood flow to healthier veins for better leg function.

tabs.label: Treatment Overview
tabs.html: Endovenous Laser Treatment (EVLT) is an advanced, non-surgical procedure used to treat varicose veins at their source. Guided by ultrasound, a very thin laser fiber is inserted into the diseased vein through a tiny puncture. Controlled pulses of laser energy gently heat and seal the vein from within, redirecting blood flow to healthier veins. This eliminates bulging veins and the discomfort they cause without traditional surgery or general anesthesia. EVLT is ideal for patients with symptomatic varicose veins who are looking for a safe, effective, in-office solution that addresses the underlying venous reflux—not just the surface appearance.

tabs.label: What to Expect
tabs.html: Your visit begins with a comprehensive venous ultrasound to map the affected veins and confirm you’re a candidate for EVLT. The skin is cleaned and numbed with a local anesthetic. A thin laser fiber is then guided into the target vein under ultrasound guidance. During the procedure, you may feel mild warmth or pressure but it’s generally well tolerated. A typical session takes about 45–60 minutes. After the procedure, a compression stocking is applied and you’ll be encouraged to walk right away. Most people resume normal daily activities the same day, with only light restrictions for the first 1–2 weeks.

tabs.label: How it Works
tabs.html: EVLT uses targeted laser energy to heat the vein wall from the inside. This controlled thermal effect causes the vein to collapse and seal shut. Over time, the closed vein is naturally absorbed by the body while blood is rerouted to healthy veins. This relieves symptoms such as heaviness, aching, swelling, and improves the cosmetic appearance of varicose veins. Because the procedure is performed under local anesthesia with ultrasound guidance, it is highly precise and spares surrounding tissue.

Periodic follow-up ultrasounds ensure optimal healing and long-term vein health.

benefits.title: Benefits of Exosome Therapy for Hair
items: Regeneration
Awakens dormant follicles so they begin producing new hair again.
Growth
Delivers powerful growth factors directly to the scalp to encourage denser, stronger strands.
Repair
Helps reverse miniaturization and damage caused by aging and hormonal changes.
Anti-Inflammation

tabs.label: Treatment Overview
tabs.html: Exosome therapy is one of the most advanced regenerative treatments available for hair restoration. Exosomes are microscopic extracellular vesicles derived from stem cells that carry growth factors, proteins, and genetic material. Acting as natural messengers, they communicate with your cells to repair tissue, regenerate follicles, and stimulate new hair growth. When applied to the scalp, exosomes work at a cellular level to reactivate dormant hair follicles, strengthen thinning strands, and improve scalp health. This treatment is non-surgical, minimally invasive, and requires no downtime, making it a safe and effective option for both men and women.

This treatment is also a great choice for people who want to strengthen their hair, stop it from falling out, or keep the results of a hair transplant.

  • Post-stress/postpartum shedders seeking non-surgical support
  • Patients wanting to optimize scalp health or maintain results after other therapies

items: Safe & Effective

tabs.label: Treatment Overview
tabs.html: Radiofrequency Ablation (RFA) is an advanced, non-surgical treatment for varicose veins that uses controlled radiofrequency energy to close diseased veins from the inside. Guided by ultrasound, a very thin catheter is inserted into the target vein through a small puncture. Radiofrequency energy then gently heats the vein wall, causing it to collapse and seal shut. This stops reflux, improves blood flow, and relieves the discomfort and appearance of varicose veins—without the need for vein stripping or general anesthesia.
tabs.text: Radiofrequency Ablation (RFA) is an advanced, non-surgical treatment for varicose veins that uses controlled radiofrequency energy to close diseased veins from the inside. Guided by ultrasound, a very thin catheter is inserted into the target vein through a small puncture. Radiofrequency energy then gently heats the vein wall, causing it to collapse and seal shut. This stops reflux, improves blood flow, and relieves the discomfort and appearance of varicose veins—without the need for vein stripping or general anesthesia.

tabs.label: What to Expect
tabs.html: Your visit starts with a detailed ultrasound examination to map the affected veins and confirm candidacy. During the procedure, the skin is numbed with local anesthesia and the radiofrequency catheter is guided into the vein under ultrasound. You may feel mild warmth or pressure but the treatment is generally comfortable. A typical RFA session takes about 30–60 minutes. After the procedure, a compression stocking is applied and you’ll be encouraged to walk immediately. Most patients return to normal activities the same day, with light restrictions for the first 1–2 weeks.

tabs.label: How it Works
tabs.html: RFA uses controlled radiofrequency energy to generate gentle heat along the vein wall, shrinking and sealing the vein from within. Over time, the treated vein is absorbed by the body and blood naturally reroutes to healthy veins. This reduces symptoms such as aching, heaviness, and swelling, while improving the cosmetic appearance of your legs. Because it’s performed under local anesthesia with ultrasound guidance, the procedure is precise and spares surrounding tissue.

Treatment Overview Radiofrequency Ablation (RFA) is an advanced, non-surgical treatment for varicose veins that uses controlled radiofrequency energy to close diseased veins from the inside. Guided by ultrasound, a very thin catheter is inserted into the target vein through a small puncture. Radiofrequency energy then gently heats the vein wall, causing it to collapse and seal shut. This stops reflux, improves blood flow, and relieves the discomfort and appearance of varicose veins—without the need for vein stripping or general anesthesia. What to Expect Your visit starts with a detailed ultrasound examination to map the affected veins and confirm candidacy. During the procedure, the skin is numbed with local anesthesia and the radiofrequency catheter is guided into the vein under ultrasound. You may feel mild warmth or pressure but the treatment is generally comfortable. A typical RFA session takes about 30–60 minutes. After the procedure, a compression stocking is applied and you’ll be encouraged to walk immediately. Most patients return to normal activities the same day, with light restrictions for the first 1–2 weeks. How it Works RFA uses controlled radiofrequency energy to generate gentle heat along the vein wall, shrinking and sealing the vein from within. Over time, the treated vein is absorbed by the body and blood naturally reroutes to healthy veins. Because it’s performed under local anesthesia with ultrasound guidance, the procedure is precise and spares surrounding tissue. Maintenance Most patients need only one RFA session per diseased vein. Additional treatments such as sclerotherapy or microphlebectomy may be recommended to treat small residual or spider veins for optimal cosmetic results. Follow-up ultrasounds ensure proper healing and long-term vein health. Pricing The cost of RFA varies based on the size and number of veins treated. tabs.label: How it Works
tabs.html: Sclerotherapy works by irritating the inner lining of the vein, causing the vein walls to stick together and close. Once closed, the vein is no longer functional and is naturally absorbed by the body. Blood flow is redirected to healthier veins, improving circulation and reducing both the appearance and symptoms of surface veins. Results are gradual: treated veins begin to fade within a few weeks, with continued improvement over several months.

Treatment Overview Spider veins, also known as telangiectasia, are small dilated blood vessels that appear close to the surface of the skin. They may develop on the face, legs, or other areas of the body. On the legs, they are often caused by genetics, pregnancy, hormonal changes, or prolonged standing, while facial spider veins are more often linked to sun exposure, aging, or conditions such as rosacea. Although not usually medically harmful, many clients choose treatment to achieve clearer, healthier-looking skin. At our clinic, we offer sclerotherapy (injections) and laser vein treatments. Depending on the type, size, and location of your spider veins, we may recommend one technique or a combination treatment for the best possible outcome. What to Expect Your treatment begins with a thorough consultation to assess your skin and determine the most effective approach. With sclerotherapy, a specialized solution is injected into the targeted veins, causing them to close and gradually fade as the body reabsorbs them. With laser vein treatment, focused light energy is applied directly to the vein, heating and collapsing it without harming surrounding skin. A session typically lasts 30 to 60 minutes depending on the number of veins treated. Most patients find the procedure comfortable with minimal downtime. Mild redness, bruising, or swelling may occur but usually subsides within a few days. How it Works Spider vein treatments work by closing off the damaged vessels and rerouting blood flow to healthier veins. Over time, the treated veins are naturally broken down and absorbed by the body, resulting in clearer, smoother skin. Initial improvements are often seen within weeks, with continued fading over several months. Maintenance For best results, most clients need two to three sessions. In cases of more extensive veins, additional treatments may be recommended. Long-term results can be maintained through healthy lifestyle habits such as wearing sun protection, avoiding prolonged standing, and using compression stockings for leg veins. Touch-up treatments may be performed as new spider veins appear over time. Treatment typically starts at $240 per session, with package options available for multi-session plans. An exact quote will be provided after your consultation. tabs.label: Treatment Overview
tabs.html: VenaSeal™ is an advanced, minimally invasive treatment for varicose veins and chronic venous insufficiency. Unlike traditional thermal treatments that use heat or injections of multiple anesthetics, VenaSeal uses a medical adhesive (cyanoacrylate) to gently seal diseased veins shut. Once sealed, blood is naturally rerouted into healthy veins, circulation improves, and the treated vein is gradually absorbed by the body. Varicose veins occur when the valves inside the veins become weak or damaged, causing blood to flow backward (venous reflux) and pool in the legs. This leads to bulging, twisted veins and symptoms such as heaviness, swelling, or pain. VenaSeal addresses the root cause by targeting the refluxing vein, improving both symptoms and appearance without the need for surgery.

Treatment Overview VenaSeal™ is an advanced, minimally invasive treatment for varicose veins and chronic venous insufficiency. Unlike traditional thermal treatments that use heat or injections of multiple anesthetics, VenaSeal uses a medical adhesive (cyanoacrylate) to gently seal diseased veins shut. Once sealed, blood is naturally rerouted into healthy veins, circulation improves, and the treated vein is gradually absorbed by the body. Varicose veins occur when the valves inside the veins become weak or damaged, causing blood to flow backward (venous reflux) and pool in the legs. This leads to bulging, twisted veins and symptoms such as heaviness, swelling, or pain. VenaSeal addresses the root cause by targeting the refluxing vein, improving both symptoms and appearance without the need for surgery. What to Expect Your consultation includes a physical exam and diagnostic ultrasound to confirm which veins are affected. On the day of treatment, the procedure is performed in-office under local anesthesia at the catheter entry site. A small catheter is inserted into the diseased vein, and a controlled amount of medical adhesive is delivered along the length of the vein. Gentle pressure is applied to help seal the vein closed. The process usually takes 30 to 60 minutes depending on the number and length of veins treated. Most patients describe the procedure as comfortable with only mild pressure or pulling sensations. Because VenaSeal does not use heat, there is no risk of thermal injury to surrounding tissue, and compression stockings are often not required afterward. Patients typically return to normal activities immediately. How it Works VenaSeal works by delivering a small amount of medical-grade adhesive inside the refluxing vein. The adhesive quickly seals the vein walls together, stopping backward blood flow. Once sealed, the vein is considered permanently closed. Over time, the body naturally absorbs the treated vein while healthy veins take over blood circulation. This process not only relieves symptoms but also reduces the appearance of varicose veins, providing long-term improvement in both comfort and aesthetics. Maintenance Most patients require only one VenaSeal session per vein, with durable results lasting for years. Because venous insufficiency is a progressive condition, new varicose veins can develop over time. Follow-up ultrasound exams and, if needed, additional treatments can help maintain smooth, healthy legs. Pricing The cost of VenaSeal treatment depends on the size and number of veins treated.. Treatment Overview Medical professionals at NewDermaMed safely and effectively remove moles for both cosmetic and medical reasons. Our team does thorough evaluations and uses advanced removal methods to help you get rid of a mole for cosmetic reasons or because it has changed in size, shape, or color. We make sure that the treatment is precise and that the results look natural with as little scarring as possible by using laser therapy, electrocautery, or surgical excision. What to Expect A professional will first look at your skin to see if removal is the right thing to do. Depending on the mole’s type, size, and location, the procedure may use laser, electrocautery, or a small surgical cut. Most of the time, local anesthesia is used to make sure the patient is comfortable, and the procedure is usually done in 30 to 60 minutes. There may be mild redness, swelling, or scabbing, but it usually goes away in a few days. Healing times differ, but most patients get smooth, natural results with little time off. How it Works Depending on the type of mole, mole removal works by getting rid of the pigmented skin growth either on the surface or deeper layers. Laser treatment goes after pigmented tissue and breaks it down to get rid of small, flat moles. Electrocautery uses heat in a controlled way to safely remove raised moles. If the mole is big or unusual, it is surgically removed and the tissue is sent for further testing if necessary. We choose each method based on your specific needs to make sure you get the safest and most effective result. Maintenance It is rare for a mole to come back after it has been taken off. Patients should keep an eye on their skin for new or changing growths, though, because finding abnormal moles early is important for skin health.
